snippet.title: [Maimaimaigoen] Game Episode 7, Part 1 (English Subs)
snippet.description:
Translations by Ganbarebenji and Anonymous Piyo ( https://twitter.com/artwaltzed )
Turn on English subtitles by clicking the CC icon at the bottom of the video.

As a Christmas gift and in celebration of Daiya's birthday, we have the first part of our episode 7 playthrough ready early this week! Thank you for all your support and happy holidays, demi!

--

Episode 7 - The Lost Path

The children somehow manage to return from the lab where the secrets of Uropia are hidden. There's a glimmer of hope that they might be able to reclaim their lost friends, but Okada remains missing.

The mysterious girl tells them that Okada Yu "re-entered" Uropia in his last attempt, and they make the decision to bring him back. They finally find him in the huge, pitch-black Okada Castle that suddenly appeared in Uropia.

As they storm inside, they're faced with attractions they had previously beat. The children must test the new selves they've discovered through the "growing pains of the heart." Confronted with the truth of Uropia, will Okada and the children be able to escape safely "together"...!?

--

About Maimaimaigoen

Maimaimaigoen is a multidimensional story about the "growing pains of the heart" of 16 children and their nursery school teachers. It examines each person as an individual and accompanies them through the difficulties of living in today's world.


Introduction

Okada Yu, a new nursery school teacher, is on a field trip to Sanrio Puroland with his students.  As they're about to head home after a fun day, his vision suddenly distorted... They wander into the mysterious amusement park Uropia where they're confronted by a strange yet oddly cute creature called "Froggy Egg." To escape from Uropia, he and the children must challenge the park's attractions and collect 10 medals...

--
